# Tukany

> Tukany is a free guitar and bass scale explorer by Lucas Marques. Players can map notes and scale degrees on a fretboard, hear individual notes, practice fingering patterns, and print a PDF for their own instrument and tuning.

The explorer supports six- and seven-string guitars and four-, five-, and six-string basses, with left- and right-handed diagrams. Shared explorer links carry the selected setup in the URL. The practice guides below can be read without running the app.

## Explorer

- [Guitar and bass scale explorer in English](https://tukany.com/)
- [Explorador de escalas para guitarra e baixo em português](https://tukany.com/pt/)
- [Explorador de escalas para guitarra y bajo en español](https://tukany.com/es/)

## Scale formulas, notes, and arpeggios in Markdown

- [Guitar and bass scale formulas](https://tukany.com/scales/index.md)
- [Fórmulas de escalas para guitarra e baixo](https://tukany.com/pt/escalas/index.md)
- [Fórmulas de escalas para guitarra y bajo](https://tukany.com/es/escalas/index.md)

## Practice guides in Markdown

- [How to practice scales on guitar and bass](https://tukany.com/practice/index.md)
- [Como praticar escalas na guitarra e no baixo](https://tukany.com/pt/pratica/index.md)
- [Cómo practicar escalas en guitarra y bajo](https://tukany.com/es/practica/index.md)

- [Baixo destro em Drop C — PDF em português](https://tukany.com/guides/bass-drop-c-right-pt.pdf)
